name: Star seeds Co.,Ltd.
summary: Established in Tokyo, Japan, in 1989, C'sMEN Co.,Ltd. functions as a dedicated retail store for casual clothing. Their diverse inventory includes outerwear such as blousons, various tops like cut-and-sewn items and knitwear, and shirts. They also stock a selection of bottoms, specifically jeans, cotton, and wool trousers. Beyond apparel, the company provides fashion accessories, including belts, caps, bags, and sneakers, alongside essential innerwear like cotton casual socks. A distinctive service offered is their parent-child matching outfit planning. Customers can acquire their products both via brick-and-mortar outlets and their e-commerce website.
